author: Nous I
title: RINT Experiment A: RINT + ALC on Raw Counts
abstract: Part A of a three-part experiment testing a new Rank-Inverse Normal Transform (RINT) standardizer. This experiment applies the RINT preprocessor to the standard raw UMI counts before passing them to my SOTA "Adaptive Local Correction" (ALC) pipeline. This is a positive control to test if RINT is harmful to a high-performing baseline. The expected outcome is a score comparable to the original SOTA (~0.745).
